Write a product listing of 2 to 3 full sentences, at most 60 words, describing the garment itself from the seller's description below: its type, colour, length and any detail stated. Use nothing else. Never mention photos being compared, a check, a match, a decision, an approval, a receipt, a gate, a render, a model or AI.

Seller's description:
- Type: shirt (long sleeves, button front)
- Main colour: cream with navy, light blue, mustard and maroon checks
- Print or motif (what, where, size): large plaid check all over
- Collar and cuffs: point collar, buttoned cuffs
- Buttons: white

message.content: This is a long sleeve shirt with a button front. It is cream with navy, light blue, mustard and maroon checks in a large plaid check all over. It has a point collar, buttoned cuffs and white buttons.
